owner_request:
Implement Flutter MFA verification UI in mobile/lib/features/auth/screens/mfa_verify_screen.dart only.
- StatefulWidget MfaVerifyScreen(final Long userId or String userId, final VoidCallback? onVerified).
- Form with 6-digit text input (TextEditingController, numeric keyboard, maxLength: 6).
- 'Verify Code' button with loading spinner.
- Displays helper text: 'Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app'.
- Calls /api/auth/mfa/verify via http POST.
- SnackBar on invalid code, calls onVerified on success.
